brief:
Zeteo reported that an Israeli attack on a hospital killed a surgeon in Gaza this week, as the territory faces a humanitarian crisis marked by deaths from exposure to harsh conditions. A baby died of hypothermia amid the ongoing conflict and deteriorating living standards affecting the enclave's civilian population.

The deaths occurred as Gaza's medical system continues to operate under severe strain from military operations in the territory.
dek: Zeteo’s weekly round-up of the stories you may have missed out of occupied Gaza and the West Bank, as Israel continues its genocidal war and apartheid policies.
title: Israeli strike kills surgeon; Gaza baby dies of cold
